title: Veo-3 animation example - Chernobyl decaying room
prompt: An abandoned, decaying room with peeling green paint, a worn red armchair holding a doll’s head, a small white chair beside it, and debris scattered across the dirty floor. Do a 180° view, slow, with radiation sound (it's in chernobyl). You can make the video a bit darker, it must sound creepy, you can also add dust if you want.
promptSource: Prompt field, Wikimedia Commons file description
promptChanges: Transcribed from the file description; surrounding quotation marks omitted.
derivative: Full shot, downscaled to 640 x 360, H.264, audio removed.
